subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the symbol that will be on the face opposite to the face showing ‘L’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a10fe9a2cc7bfddac34d3b4972ce5637fdd888f1016e9cca4904d8b17cf9f84.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'L', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2893753a2084f057dd8ab8f780d6aab34bf377fb20e2eecb9801eca682c4d92c.png] 

From both dices, L is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

$ is opposite to @.

% is opposite to &.

So, # will be opposite to L.

Hence, the correct answer is "#".
